name: three_endpoint_trend_conditioned_certificate_probability_v1
domain: Original PVR actually filled first MOBILE entries only; 1814 expected. No CORE, E31, unfilled-candidate extrapolation or new policy.

feature_formula.T: OLS slope of native log close at original anchor a-21..a inclusive; sign >=0 is plus. Same source segment required.
feature_formula.E: min(original CP displacement, original CP credit)
feature_formula.V: Existing audited CE variance budget: sum prior21 same-segment squared-return means over original formation observations, floored at log(1.001)^2; anchor excluded; exact original reset/consumption lineage.
feature_formula.R: log(original signal native close / original first_role_floor), positive required; verify candidate-time floor identity.

priors.children: Independently conditional on pi0, Dirichlet(20*pi0). Same prior rule for joint and speed comparator.
priors.tuning: None. Full posterior prediction, not probability-space MAP.

clock.fit: First common trading session monthly, information through preceding close. Original signal in prior504 sessions and actual entry index <=cut-120. Uniform potential follow-up required even for early exits.
clock.labels: W positive actual complete net round exit within120 inclusive sessions from actual entry; L nonpositive complete exit within120; U still open at120. All late exits remain U at H even if later known.
clock.target: Final actual0-to-0 positive-exit probability is partially identified by [pW,pW+pU]; do not report midpoint or pW as ultimate win probability.

identification.check: No outcome labels read for first-stage feature/matrix audit. Require X full column rank for eligible candidate months; condition numbers reported.
identification.numeric_stop: Rank deficiency or condition number above1e8 for an otherwise eligible month -> joint output UNKNOWN for that month; no new branch or threshold.

numerics.posterior: Logit-coordinate posterior with exact Jacobian; numerical optimizer only finds proposal center. Four seeded adaptive-warmup random-walk Metropolis chains. Randomness is posterior integration, never security selection.
numerics.diagnostics: Split rank-normalized Rhat<=1.01 and bulk ESS>=400 on all endpoint probabilities and logits. One fixed extension permitted only for numerical convergence; otherwise model-month UNKNOWN. No results-based retry.
numerics.bounds: Optimizer logits[-25,25] only for numerical starting mode; MCMC unbounded.

comparisons: Same eligible data, same mature-H test cohorts and same minimum criteria for constant/speed/joint. Paired three-state Brier and logloss; rank and calibration are separate.

evaluation.primary: 2023-2025 signal cohorts with120 sessions of potential follow-up by source end, irrespective of early closure.2026 partial coverage and observed complete-round diagnostics separately, not full-year/H-mature evaluation.
evaluation.secondary: Observed actual final0-to-0 net results by source end, keeping opens unknown and listing all-birth win bounds. No recomputed account results.
evaluation.uncertainty: 20-common-session entry-date blocks, stock clusters and conservative max of one-way/two-way cluster variances; paired AUC influence estimates. Descriptive, conditional on fitted models; omits refitting uncertainty.
evaluation.score_groups: Training-score20/40/60/80percentiles frozen monthly; all groups reported. No selection threshold derived from outcomes.
metrics: known final win AUC as descriptive only
evaluation.history: All history previously reviewed.2024/2025 repeatedly consumed; not genuine untouched OOS.

restrictions: no30percent claim from a selected historical bin
stop if no discrimination; do not retune
